definitions.explanation: The outer layer or exterior of something.
What appears on the outside, as opposed to what is hidden or internal.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}の{表面|ひょうめん}に{氷|こおり}が{張|は}っている。
examples.english: Ice has formed on the surface of the water.

examples.japanese: {表面|ひょうめん}は{平|へい}{和|わ}に{見|み}えるが、{内|うち}{部|ぶ}では{問題|もんだい}がある。
examples.english: On the surface it looks peaceful, but there are problems inside.

examples.japanese: {表面|ひょうめん}{張力|ちょうりょく}について{学|まな}んだ。

notes:
USAGE: {表面|ひょうめん} can be literal (physical surface) or figurative (outward appearance).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{表面|ひょうめん}に (on the surface)
・{表面|ひょうめん}{上|じょう} (superficially, on the surface)
・{表面|ひょうめん}{的|てき} (superficial)
・{表面|ひょうめん}を{磨|みが}く (to polish the surface)

ANTONYM: {裏面|りめん} (reverse side, back surface)
